patterns: The only relevant APPSC PYQ is a one-liner: outsourcing is the recently popular method of employing persons. APPSC treats this topic at a basic-concept level.
Other exams ask Pay Commission chair names (7th = Justice A.K. Mathur) and UPSC-style 'which reduce the size of the State' sets (FDI is not one).
Likely traps: 'steering, not rowing' (Osborne-Gaebler) vs 'serve, not steer' (Denhardt); Hood 1991; 5-6-7 Pay Commission = Pandian-Srikrishna-Mathur; 7th CPC effective 2016.

The app is far more theory-heavy (Hood's doctrines, ten principles, Public Value, GRAI/NeSDA) and data-heavy (union share, contract labour). It uses multi-statement and match items well beyond the PYQ depth.
